text:
Type: tall cabinet with doors and drawers
Use: storing clothes, toys, books and supplies; children's room, bedroom, playroom
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: white painted board, cut-out handles
Colors: bright white, black handle recesses
Shape: tall narrow cabinet with two doors on top and three drawers below, rectangular cut-out pulls, flat top, plinth base, slim and upright
Feel: clean, tidy, calm, bright
Goes with: white walls, light wood, pastel or bright accents; Scandinavian children's rooms or minimalist bedrooms

product.name: STUVA
product.description: You can keep both hanging and folded clothes in this wardrobe, since it has a clothes rail, shelf and drawers.
